game_concept: A tower defense set in Sand Dunes – Sandstorm Pass, a pass in a sandstorm: the caravan guide must hold off mirage spirits while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Integration Heist: Combine loops, conditionals, and lists to complete a multi-step script that raids Sandstorm Pass.
theme: Sand Dunes – Sandstorm Pass: a pass in a sandstorm
core_gameplay_loop: In Sandstorm Pass, repeat each round: Combine loops, conditionals, and lists to complete a multi-step script that raids Sandstorm Pass. Then check heist and advance.
player_objective: Protect the supply tent from mirage spirits in Sandstorm Pass: keep heist above zero until the 67-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 7 (applied tier): Integration Heist
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 9, Level 7, Need Assistance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
